pairs.question: Quid actum est fili mi?
pairs.answer: Fugit Israhel coram Philisthim et ruina magna facta est in populo insuper et duo filii tui mortui sunt Ofni et Finees et arca Dei capta est.
pairs.derivation: Heli's question; the asking-frame 'cui ille ait' is dropped. Answer frame 'respondens autem qui nuntiabat ... inquit' dropped (inquit is interleaved). The reply is one contiguous sentence reporting the disaster; kept whole through 'capta est'.

pairs.question: Ecce ibimus quid feremus ad virum? Panis defecit in sitarciis nostris et sportulam non habemus ut demus homini Dei nec quicquam aliud.
pairs.answer: Ecce inventa est in manu mea quarta pars stateris argenti.
pairs.derivation: Saul's whole utterance kept contiguous so 'virum' (the man of God) has a referent. Frame 'dixitque Saul ad puerum suum' dropped. Answer frame 'rursum puer respondit Sauli et ait' dropped; cut after 'argenti' (what follows, 'demus homini Dei ut indicet...', is a follow-on proposal, not the answer to what to bring).

pairs.question: Num hic est videns?
pairs.derivation: Saul's party asks the maidens; frame 'et dixerunt eis' dropped. Answer frame 'quae respondentes dixerunt illis' dropped; cut at the first answering unit, before 'festina nunc...' which elaborates.

pairs.question: Ubi est domus videntis?
pairs.derivation: Saul's indirect interrogative; asking-frame 'et ait indica oro mihi' dropped (meta-narration of asking). Answer frame 'et respondit Samuhel Sauli dicens' dropped; cut at first full stop, before 'ascende ante me...' (invitation, not answer).

pairs.question: Quo abistis?
pairs.derivation: Uncle's question; frame 'dixitque patruus Saul ad eum et ad puerum eius' dropped. Answer frame 'qui responderunt' dropped; cut after 'asinas' (the direct answer to 'where'), before 'quas cum non repperissemus venimus ad Samuhelem' which elaborates.

pairs.question: Quid dixerit tibi Samuhel?
pairs.answer: Indicavit nobis quia inventae essent asinae.
pairs.derivation: Uncle's indirect question; asking-frame 'et dixit ei patruus suus indica mihi' dropped. Answer frame 'et ait Saul ad patruum suum' dropped; cut after 'asinae', before 'de sermone autem regni non indicavit ei...' which reverts to narration.

pairs.question: Quid feceris?
pairs.answer: Gustans gustavi in summitate virgae quae erat in manu mea paululum mellis.
pairs.derivation: Saul's indirect question; asking-frame 'dixit autem Saul ad Ionathan indica mihi' dropped. Answer frame 'et indicavit ei Ionathan et ait' dropped; cut after 'mellis', before 'et ecce ego morior' which is a resigned lament, not an answer to 'what did you do'.

pairs.question: Numquid iam conpleti sunt filii?
pairs.answer: Adhuc reliquus est parvulus et pascit oves.
pairs.derivation: Samuel's question; frame 'dixitque Samuhel ad Isai' dropped. Answer frame 'qui respondit' dropped; cut before the next turn 'et ait Samuhel ad Isai mitte et adduc eum...'.

pairs.question: De qua progenie es o adulescens?
pairs.answer: Filius servi tui Isai Bethleemitae ego sum.
pairs.derivation: Saul's question; frame 'et ait ad eum Saul' dropped. Answer frame 'dixitque David' dropped; the reply is a single self-identifying clause kept whole.

pairs.question: Quid feci quae est iniquitas mea et quod peccatum meum in patrem tuum quia quaerit animam meam?
pairs.derivation: David's whole interrogative plea kept contiguous and verbatim; narration-frame 'fugit autem David... veniensque locutus est coram Ionathan' dropped. Answer frame 'qui dixit ei' dropped; cut at first full stop, before 'neque enim faciet pater meus...' which elaborates the reassurance.

pairs.question: Num vadam et percutiam Philistheos istos?
pairs.answer: Vade et percuties Philistheos et salvabis Ceila.
pairs.derivation: David's consultation; asking-frame 'consuluit igitur David Dominum dicens' dropped. Answer frame 'et ait Dominus ad David' dropped; the reply is one contiguous command kept whole.

pairs.question: Num vox tua est haec fili mi David?
pairs.derivation: Saul's question; frame 'cognovit autem Saul vocem David et dixit' dropped. Answer frame 'et David' (i.e. 'and David said') dropped; David's confirming reply kept whole.

pairs.question: Quem suscitabo tibi?
pairs.derivation: The woman's question; frame 'dixitque ei mulier' dropped. Answer frame 'qui ait' dropped; Saul's reply kept whole.

pairs.question: Quid vidisti?
pairs.derivation: Saul's question; asking-frame 'dixitque ei rex noli timere' dropped (reassurance + speech tag). Answer frame 'et ait mulier ad Saul' dropped; the reply kept whole.

pairs.question: Qualis est forma eius?
pairs.answer: Vir senex ascendit et ipse amictus est pallio.
pairs.derivation: Saul's question; frame 'dixitque ei' dropped. Answer frame 'quae ait' dropped; cut after 'pallio', before 'intellexit Saul quod Samuhel esset...' which returns to narration.

pairs.question: Quare inquietasti me ut suscitarer?
pairs.answer: Coartor nimis siquidem Philisthim pugnant adversum me et Deus recessit a me et exaudire me noluit neque in manu prophetarum neque per somnia vocavi ergo te ut ostenderes mihi quid faciam.
pairs.derivation: Samuel's question; frame 'dixit autem Samuhel ad Saul' dropped. Answer frame 'et ait Saul' dropped; the reply is a single contiguous sentence (no internal full stop) giving the reason Saul summoned him, kept whole.

pairs.question: Cuius es tu vel unde quo pergis?
pairs.answer: Puer aegyptius ego sum servus viri amalechitae dereliquit autem me dominus meus quia aegrotare coepi nudius tertius.
pairs.derivation: David's question; frame 'dixit itaque ei David' dropped. Answer frame 'qui ait ei' dropped; the reply is one contiguous sentence answering whose/whence, kept whole.
